झ: झ 1. झ, the ninth consonant of the Sanskrit alphabet and the aspirate of the preceding letter. —झ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound झ्।

झ 2. झ, अस्, आ, अम्, asleep, sleeping; lost, destroyed; (अस्), m. a peculiar sound; playing a tune, beating time; a sound like the splashing of water or the clashing of symbols, jingling, clanking, &c.; wind accompanied by rain; a stray, a thing lost or mislaid; a N. of a chief of the Daityas or demons; an epithet of Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of the gods; (आ), f. the descent of a cascade, a water-fall.
झगझगाय: झगझगाय झगझगाय, nom. A. झगझ-गायते, to sparkle, flash.
झङ्कार: झङ्कार झङ्-कार, अस्, m. or झङ्-कारित, अम्, n. (fr. the imitative word झम्), a low murmuring sound, as the buzzing or humming of bees &c.
झञ्झन: झञ्झन झञ्झन, अम्, n. (onomatopoetic), an indistinct noise like the jingling and clanking of metal ornaments, any ringing or rattling sound.
झञ्झा: झञ्झा, f. the noise of the wind or of falling rain; wind, wind and rain, a hurricane, a gale; a clang or sharp clanking sound, jingling; raining in large drops; a stray, anything lost. —झञ्झानिल (°झा-अन्°), अस्, m. wind with rain, a high wind in the rainy season, a typhoon or the sort of tempest frequent during the south-west monsoon. —झञ्झा-वात, अस्, m. wind with rain, a storm, a squall.
झट्: झट् झट्, cl. 1. P. झटति, &c., to become matted together or entangled (as hair), to become confused or intermixed.
झटा: झटा, f. the plant Flacourtia Cataphracta.
झटि: झटि, इस्, m. a small tree, a shrub, a bush.
झाट: झाट, अस्, m. an arbour, bower, place overgrown with creepers; a wood, a thicket; cleaning sores or wounds; (आ or ई), f. jasmine, Jasminum Auriculatum.
झाट झाट। See under rt. झट्।
झाटल: झाटल, अस्, m. the tree Bignonia Suaveolens.
झाटिका: झाटिका or झाटीका, f. = झाटा above.
झटिति: झटिति झटिति, ind. (fr. झट्, an onomato-poetic word with इति; cf. पटिति), quickly, speedily, instantly; at once; on the spot.
झणझण: झणझण झणझण or झणझणा (an ono-matopoetic word), the jingling or tinkling of orna-ments; [cf. छनच्छन् and झलज्झला।] —झण-झणी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, rattling.
झणझणाय: झणझणाय, nom. A. -यते, &c., to jingle, tinkle.
झणत्कार: झणत्कार झणत्-कार or झनत्-कार, अस्, m. (fr. the imitative sound झणत् and कार), the jingling, tinkling, or clinking of metallic ornaments.
झम्: झम् झम्, cl. 1. P. झमति, &c. = छम् and जम्, to eat, consume.
झम्प: झम्प झम्प, अस्, आ, m. f. a spring, a jump, jumping, springing, plunging. —झम्पाशिन् (°प-आश्°), ई, m. a kingfisher.
झम्पाक: झम्पाक, अस्, m. or झम्पारु, उस्, m. a monkey, an ape.
झम्पिन्: झम्पिन्, ई, m. ‘a leaper,’ an ape, a monkey.
झर: झर झर, अस्, आ or ई, m. f. a cascade, a water-fall; (ई), f. a river; [cf. निर्-झर।]
झरत्: झरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flowing or falling down; [cf. क्षर्।]
झर्च्: झर्च् झर्च्, cl. 6. P. झर्चति, or झर्छ्, cl. 6. P. झर्छति, or झर्झ्, cl. 6. P. झर्झति, to speak; to blame, menace; injure.
झर्झर: झर्झर झर्झर, अस्, ई, m. f. (said to be fr. the last), a sort of drum; (अस्), m. the Kali-yuga, the present Yuga or age of the world; N. of a Daitya, a son of Hiraṇyākṣa; N. of a river; (आ), f. a whore [cf. ऋच्छरा]; (अम्), n. a sound as of splashing or dropping.
झर्झरक: झर्झरक, अस्, m. the fourth or present age of the world, the Kali-yuga.
झर्झरिन्: झर्झरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, furnished with a drum; epi-thet of Śiva.
झर्झरीक: झर्झरीक झर्झरीक, अस्, m. the body; a region, a country; a picture.
झलक्का: झलक्का झलक्का, f. a large flame.
झलज्झला: झलज्झला झलज्झला, f. an onomatopoetic word for the noise of falling drops, the flapping of an elephant's ears, or of flaccid breasts, &c.
झलरी: झलरी झलरी, f. = झर्झर, a sort of drum; a curl; [cf. झल्लरी।]
झला: झला झला, f. a girl, a daughter; sun-shine, splendor, brilliant or glittering light; a cricket; [cf. झिल्ली; cf. also rt. ज्वल्; Hib. gal, ‘heat;’ galla, ‘fairness, brightness, beauty;’ gallad, ‘a lass, a young girl.’]
झलि: झलि झलि, इस्, f. the areca-nut.
झल्ल: झल्ल झल्ल, अस्, m. a prize-fighter, a cudgel-player, a man of a tribe following the profession of a Jhalla; a designation of one of the degraded classes sprung from an outcast Kṣatriya; (ई), f. a kind of drum.
झल्लक: झल्लक झल्लक, अम्, n. (fr. झल्ल, imitative sound), cymbals; (ई), f. a kind of drum.
झल्लकण्ठ: झल्लकण्ठ झल्लकण्ठ, अस्, m. a pigeon; [cf. झिल्ली-कण्ठ।]
झल्लना: झल्लना झल्लना, f. a particular Prākṛt metre.
झल्लरी: झल्लरी झल्लरी, f. (fr. झल्ल, imitative sound; cf. झलरी), a kind of musical instrument, a sort of drum or cymbal; a curl, a lock of hair; moisture; purity; a ball &c. of perfumed substances used for cleaning the hair; [cf. झलरी and झिल्लरी।]
झल्लिका: झल्लिका झल्लिका, f. a rag or cloth used for applying colour or perfumes; dirt rubbed off the body by the application of perfumes; light, splendor, lustre; [cf. झिल्लिका।]
झल्लीषक: झल्लीषक झल्लीषक, a sort of musical instrument.
झल्लोल: झल्लोल झल्लोल, अस्, m. a ball or protuber-ance at the lower end of a spindle.
झष्: झष् झष्, cl. 1. P. A. झषति, -ते, &c., to take; to put on, wear, cover; (only P.) to hurt or kill.
झष: झष, अस्, m. a large fish, a fish in general; the sign of the zodiac Pisces; a forest, a thicket; a forest overgrown with grass; heat, warmth; (आ), f. the plant Uraria Lagopodioides; (अम्), n. a desert. —झष-केतन or झष-ध्वज, अस्, m. a N. of Kandarpa or the god of love; love. —झषाङ्क (°ष-अङ्°), अस्, m. an epithet of Aniruddha or the son of Kāma. —झषाशन (°ष-अश्°), अस्, m. the Gangetic porpoise, Delphinus Gangeticus. —झषो-दरी (°ष-उद्°), f. an epithet of Satyavatī, the wife of Sāntanu and mother of Vyāsa.
झाङ्कृत: झाङ्कृत झाङ्-कृत, अम्, n. (fr. झाम्, imita-tive sound, and rt. 1. कृ), a tinkling ornament worn round the toes or feet.
झाटामला: झाटामला झाटामला, f. = झाटा, Jasminum Auriculatum; (according to others two separate words, झाटा and अमला।)
झाटास्त्रक: झाटास्त्रक झाटास्त्रक, अस्, m. the water melon.
झाबुक: झाबुक झाबुक, अस्, m. the tree Tamarix Indica (?); [cf. झावुक।]
झामक: झामक झामक, अम्, n. a burnt or vitrified brick.
झामर: झामर झामर, अस्, m. a small whetstone, used chiefly by housewives for sharpening their spin-dles, needles, &c.
झार्झर: झार्झर झार्झर or झार्झरिक, अस्, m. (fr. झर्झर), a tabor-player, a drummer.
झालरी: झालरी झालरी [cf. झलरी], a kind of drum or tabor.
झाला: झाला झाला, f. = झला, q. v.
झालि: झालि झालि, इस्, f. a sort of sour or unripe mango fried with salt, mustard, and Asa Fœtida.
झावु: झावु झावु, उस्, m. the tree Tamarix In-dica; also झावुक, अस्, m. and झावू, ऊस्, m.
झिङ्गाक: झिङ्गाक झिङ्गाक, अस्, m. a sort of cucum-ber, Luffa Acutangula.
झिङ्गिनी: झिङ्गिनी झिङ्गिनी, f. a sort of cucumber, Luffa Acutangula; a torch, a firebrand.
झिङ्गी: झिङ्गी, f. a sort of cucumber, Luffa Acutangula.
झिज्जी: झिज्जी झिज्जी, f. = झिल्ली, a cricket; [cf. झिञ्झी।]
झिञ्झिम: झिञ्झिम झिञ्झिम, अस्, m. a forest on fire.
झिञ्झिरा: झिञ्झिरा झिञ्झिरा and झिञ्झिरिष्टा, f., N. of a shrub.
झिञ्झी: झिञ्झी झिञ्झी, f. = झिल्ली, a cricket.
झिण्टी: झिण्टी झिण्टी, f. a shrub, Barleria Cristata; नीला झिण्टी, Barleria Cærulea.
झिरिका: झिरिका झिरिका or झिरी or झिरीका or झि-रुका, f. a cricket.
झिल्लरी: झिल्लरी झिल्लरी, f. = झल्लरी, q. v.
झिल्लि: झिल्लि झिल्लि, इस्, f. a cricket; a kind of musical instrument; membrane or parchment; [cf. झिल्ली; cf. also Lat. gryllus; Germ. Grille.]
झिल्लिका: झिल्लिका, f. a cricket; a cricket's cry; the light of sunshine, strong light, splendor; the dirt which comes from the body in rubbing it with perfumes; a cloth or rag used for applying colour, unguents, &c.; a kind of skin or membrane, parchment. —झिल्लिका-गण-नादित, अस्, आ, अम्, resounding with a multitude of crickets.
झिल्ली: झिल्ली, f. a cricket; the wick of a lamp; a cloth or rag for applying unguents, colour, &c.; sunshine, light, lustre; rice burnt by cooking in a saucepan, &c.; a musical instrument, cymbals; parchment. —झिल्ली-कण्ठ, अस्, m. a domestic pigeon.
झिल्लीक: झिल्लीक, अस्, m. a cricket; (आ), f. a cricket; sun-shine; dirt taken off the body in rubbing it with perfumes.
झीरिका: झीरिका and झीरुका, f. a cricket.
झिल्लिन्: झिल्लिन् झिल्लिन्, ई, m., N. of a Vṛṣṇi.
झु: झु झु, cl. 1. A. झवते, &c., to go or move.
झुण्ट: झुण्ट झुण्ट, अस्, m. a shrub, a bush.
झुमरि: झुमरि झुमरि or झुमेरि, इस्, f. one of the Rāgiṇīs or modes of music personified.
झूणि: झूणि झूणि, इस्, f. a kind of betel-nut; a voice or communication from heaven boding ill-luck, evil omen; a thicket &c. (= कठिन।)
झूष्: झूष् झूष्, cl. 1. P. झूषति, to hurt, kill; (a various reading for यूष्।)
झॄ: झॄ झॄ (another form of rt. 1. जॄ), cl. 4. 9. P. झीर्यति, झृणाति, &c., to become old.
झोड: झोड झोड, अस्, m. the betel-nut tree.
झौलिक: झौलिक झौलिक, a small bag for betel &c.
झ्यु: झ्यु झ्यु, cl. 1. P. झ्यवति, &c., to go or move.
